SCIENCE, NATURE & DISCOVERY WORKSHEETS

Science, Nature & Discovery worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Predict, sort, count and discover — the printable twins of the Science Adventures: plant growth, weather, insects, magnets, habitats and one graduation lab. Every sheet twins with a real game in Science, Nature & Discovery (Class 31) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.

Bunny’s Plant Growth Lab Age 4Class 31Science Seed, sprout, seedling, sunflower — write 1, 2, 3 and 4 to show how a plant grows.
